name: sheepit
description: Reports coding-agent state (busy / waiting / idle), the last exchange, and any pull request or issue the agent touched, to the sheepit session that owns this terminal — so panes light up the moment a turn ends, sessions are named from what was actually asked, and the pane bar shows the PR without anything reading the terminal. Works with Claude Code and Codex; Pi gets the same reports from an extension (plugin/pi/sheepit.js), since it has no hooks.
